page.overview:
What is Afghanistan?

Afghanistan is a country in central Asia.

Alamut, the former headquarters of the Banu Haqim, is located somewhere in Afghanistan.

There is a caern in the Panjshir Valley near a village where a sept hold a mixed-school which was a first for Samira Rahmani when her and her siblings arrived as children there. The sept was lead by a pack named Will of Five Wolves, after the Panjshir Valley which was known as the Valley of Five Lions, however the sept was weaken by the return of the Taliban regime, as the Garou population mostly dispersed because of it.

Afghanistan is known as the stronghold of the Taftâni.
